# Jump { #timetoalign.timelines.Jump }

```python
timelines.Jump(
    coordinate,
    targets,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
)
```

Where the flow may leave the axis, and every place it may go on at.

One Jump lies at a coordinate; several signs at one place (a repeat end
and a D.S. on one barline, the brackets of alternative endings) are the
destinations of that Jump. When the flow plays up to the Jump, the
destinations that hold are found and one of them is taken; when none
holds, the flow goes on.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name       | Type                                                                                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                                     | Where the flow leaves: the end of the measure before.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| targets    | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[JumpDestination](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.JumpDestination`), ...\] | The destinations, at least one, each with a place of its own: no two with the same ``to``, the same ``by``, or both without place. They carry no order and are held and written in the canonical one, whatever order they are given in: the destination without place, then those with ``by``, by value, then those with ``to``, by ID. |
| name       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                            | A display name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| label      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                            | A human-readable label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| meta       | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                             | Additional metadata.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| provenance | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None         | How the Jump was made and who believes it: provenance entries, or None.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| id         | [str](`str`)                                                                                    | The Jump's ID; minted with the prefix ``jump`` when not given.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> repeat = Jump(
...     Coordinate(64, TimeUnit.quarters),
...     [JumpDestination(repeat_count=1, manifestation="repeat_end")],
...     id="repeat",
... )
>>> repeat.id, repeat.manifestations
('repeat', ("repeat_end",))
>>> repeat.to_dict()["targets"]
[{'repeat_count': 1, 'manifestation': 'repeat_end'}]
```
